tests.name: population_reconciliation
tests.assertion: class counts sum to legacy row count

tests.name: candidate_gap_reconciliation
tests.assertion: legacy/candidate counts and path intersection reported by class

tests.name: identity_stability
tests.assertion: repeat build yields identical class-aware identity set and hashes

tests.name: authority_provenance
tests.assertion: authority comes from governed source fields or explicit unknown, never presence alone

tests.name: transient_exclusion
tests.assertion: cache/transient classes excluded from production projection unless human-approved

tests.name: behavioral_queries
tests.assertion: critical legacy queries are compared per retained class

tests.name: checkpoint_resume
tests.assertion: workspace inventory resumes from verified checkpoint without duplicate assignments
